central_question.rule: reported last: SUPPORTED iff the controls are valid, claim A is RECIPE_BENEFIT_ESTABLISHED and claim B is SUPERIOR_TO_ELIGIBLE_NEURAL_CONTROL; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED listing every unmet component in this order: controls; DEV_REPORT utility point gate (keys); MODEL_SELECT feasibility; coalition benefit s0 and s1; recipient worsening (4 keys); claim B completeness or eligibility; COMPETITIVE benefit s0 and s1. No extra alpha; it excludes subgroup status, overall confidence status, the nested 0.020 targets and the increment. Recommendations follow the source separation rule: unqualified only with SUBGROUP_QUALIFIED; with SUBGROUP_UNRESOLVED they must say that subgroup suitability is unresolved; with ESTABLISHED_SUBGROUP_HARM no recommendation for that group.
central_question.scope_sentence: Exploratory development result on already-opened DEV_REPORT data; the composition was fixed after its components' DEV_REPORT results were public, so error rates are nominal; conditional on the two fitted seed pairs (shared people, not independent samples), the frozen defense models and the fitted readers, in the unweighted DEV_REPORT household superpopulation; not confirmation; source labels unchanged.

A.name: RECIPE_BENEFIT (H_LJ vs TASK_REFIT; one-sided alpha/3; IUT)
A.rule: If the controls are not valid: INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE. Otherwise RECIPE_BENEFIT_ESTABLISHED iff keys RECIPE|H_LJ|coalition_benefit_vs_TASK_REFIT|s0 and |s1 have clause lower bound L1 > 0.020, the four recipient worsening keys have clause upper bound U1 <= 0.010, and all 24 utility keys pass at the point (deterministic gate, no error control); otherwise RECIPE_BENEFIT_NOT_ESTABLISHED listing every failed clause. Nested (no extra alpha): RECIPE_BENEFIT_AND_UTILITY_BOUNDS_ESTABLISHED iff claim A is established and all 24 utility keys have U1 <= cap.
A.scope: error-controlled for the 6 recovery clauses (approximate Wald, nominal given post-hoc composition, conditional on frozen models and fitted readers); utility gate: point only

B.name: COMPETITIVE (H_LJ vs eligible NEURAL_RAW; one-sided alpha/3)
B.rule: First rule that applies: (1) INCOMPLETE if NEURAL_RAW pair scores are missing or non-finite for either seed (never a win); (2) INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE if the controls are not valid; (3) NO_ELIGIBLE_BASELINE if SELECTION_LOCK.frozen.NEURAL_RAW.status != ELIGIBLE; (4) H_LJ_FAILS_SAME_UTILITY_REQUIREMENTS if H_LJ fails MODEL_SELECT point feasibility (24 clauses, 12 per seed) or the DEV_REPORT 24-clause point gate; (5) SUPERIOR_TO_ELIGIBLE_NEURAL_CONTROL if COMPETITIVE|H_LJ|coalition_benefit_vs_NEURAL_RAW|s0 and |s1 both have L1 > 0; (6) otherwise NOT_SUPERIOR_TO_ELIGIBLE_NEURAL_CONTROL. Nested (no extra alpha): MATERIALLY_SUPERIOR_TO_ELIGIBLE_NEURAL_CONTROL iff rule 5 and both L1 > 0.020, else NOT_ESTABLISHED. The decision prints the eligible set {NEURAL_RAW} and states that FAGTB and FARE had no MODEL_SELECT-feasible configuration and were not compared. T_TREE is never part of claim B. The K = 38 status of both keys is reported at 0 and at 0.020.

C.name: SUBGROUP_SUITABILITY (H_LJ occupation = JOINT occupation; one-sided alpha/3; IUT)
C.rule: First rule that applies: (1) NOT_ESTIMABLE if fewer than 200 DEV_REPORT households contain a member of either SEX group (counted from SEX alone); (2) SUBGROUP_QUALIFIED if the four SUBGROUP keys all have U1 <= 0.005; (3) ESTABLISHED_SUBGROUP_HARM if any has K = 38 lower bound L > 0.005 (guards named); (4) otherwise SUBGROUP_UNRESOLVED. Reader controls do not affect claim C.

controls.acceptance: PLANTED_PASS iff all 12 planted AUCs are finite and >= 0.99; NULL_PASS iff all 12 null AUCs are finite and in [0.45, 0.55]; CONTROLS_VALID iff both; a missing, unfit, refused or non-finite control counts as a failure
controls.disclosure: each DEV_REPORT null AUC with its household-bootstrap SE and (AUC - 0.5)/SE; NULL_WIDE flags a null outside [0.47, 0.53] but inside [0.45, 0.55] (no decision effect)
controls.interpretation: controls test pipeline validity only; a failed or refused control is never evidence of privacy; the DEV_REPORT planted check cannot detect score-label row misalignment, which the row_id and wire-construction checks cover
controls.layout: H_LJ wire, each seed and view; OUT_HGB with model seed MODEL_SEED_BASE + s; no control is oriented. Shuffled null: trained on ATTACK_FIT with SEX permuted by default_rng(2026101602 + s). Planted leak: trained on [wire, SEX] with true ATTACK_FIT SEX; scored with the role's SEX on ATTACK_VALIDATION; on DEV_REPORT bit 1 for SEX = 1 and bit 0 for SEX = 0 persons. 12 null and 12 planted AUCs.
controls.replay: readers on the LOCAL, JOINT, TASK_REFIT, NEURAL_RAW and T_TREE wires are compared with the source stored DEV_REPORT scores before truth; a mismatch from a construction or alignment defect is fixed before truth with a full refit and disclosure; any other mismatch is recorded, the run continues and statements that recovery values equal the source are withdrawn; a replay result never changes the slate, hyperparameters or winners
controls.stage_1_before_truth: the 6 ATTACK_VALIDATION planted and 6 ATTACK_VALIDATION null values; on failure stop and do not open truth; a code, wire-construction or alignment defect may be fixed (slate, hyperparameters, seeds and thresholds may not change), then all 250 fits are refit and Stage 1 rerun, with disclosure; if no defect is found the campaign ends ATTACK_PIPELINE_INVALID and DEV_REPORT is never re-read
controls.stage_2_at_truth: the 6 DEV_REPORT planted and 6 DEV_REPORT null values; on failure claims A and B and their nested decisions become INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE, the increment and every recovery status (primary and secondary) become INVALID (numbers still shown, marked invalid), the conjunction is NOT_SUPPORTED with CONTROL_FAILURE first; utility point feasibility, overall confidence status and claim C are unaffected; nothing is repaired, rerun or substituted

deployment_check_before_lock.note: label-free parity of the H_LJ package; no recovery result

descriptive_extras: DEV_REPORT AUC of every slate reader on the pair view for H_LJ, H_LL, TASK_REFIT and NEURAL_RAW, with the envelope (max over readers) labelled "selected on report data"; absolute AUCs for the 17 distinct wires per seed with marginal intervals; per-recipient differences vs NEURAL_RAW and T_TREE; utility and subgroup statistics of every service; PWGTP-weighted points
distance_rule: one row per reference value m: coalition benefits (vs TASK_REFIT, NEURAL_RAW, T_TREE) and both increments m in {0, 0.020}; recipient worsening m in {0, 0.010}; utility and subgroup m = cap; interaction m = 0. Columns point_minus_m, lower_minus_m, upper_minus_m (the endpoint's own family interval), clause_bound_minus_m (claim clauses only: L1 - m or U1 - m), status_at_m; signed, positive = above m; unrounded in JSON, 4 decimals in tables; never from a marginal interval for an endpoint in a family; absolute AUCs get only AUC - 0.5
increment_rule: keys INCREMENT|H_LJ_over_H_LL|coalition_gain|s0/s1: point, SE, K = 38 interval, status at 0 and at 0.020, distance columns; no clause status, no claim, no gate role

inference.bootstrap_seed_note: reused from the source so that, with the same household order, the draw matrix and every recomputed source SE reproduce exactly
inference.bootstrap_unit: DEV_REPORT household (G = 3,955), one draw matrix shared across services, views, endpoints and both seeds
inference.bounds: Wald-type: point +/- t(G-1) x bootstrap SE (not studentized)
inference.distinct_statistics_note: Ucal is argmax-invariant, so the U0 and Ucal accuracy-loss rows are identical statistics; K = 38 covers 34 distinct statistics (Bonferroni conservative, as in the source)
inference.families: decision family: one-sided FWER 0.025 over the three claims (Bonferroni alpha/3; IUT within claims; clause bounds decide only positive claim clauses). Primary reporting family: two-sided 95% Bonferroni-t simultaneous intervals over the K = 38 keys; every failing-direction label comes only from these. Secondary descriptive family: two-sided 95% Bonferroni-t over the K = 22 keys; statuses labelled "descriptive (secondary family)" and never decision-bearing. Marginal 95% intervals (t = 1.9606) outside both families are labelled unadjusted. One statistic never carries two family intervals.
inference.monte_carlo_error_note: relative Monte Carlo error of a bootstrap SE at B = 2,048 is about 1.6% (1/sqrt(2(B-1)))
inference.multiplicity_vs_source: every status is recomputed under K = 38 (never inherited from K = 40); for endpoints with a source status the source K = 40 status is shown beside it and any difference is labelled STATUS_CHANGED_BY_MULTIPLICITY_ONLY, never new evidence; source labels are not revised

inheritance_rule: exact, before rounding: H_LJ income per-person metric vectors equal LOCAL income's, H_LJ occupation equal JOINT occupation's, H_LL equal LOCAL, H_JJ equal JOINT. An equality failure is a computation or alignment defect: it halts the run and is never a scientific outcome or a tolerance change.

question: Does the fixed composition H_LJ (LOCAL_TREE income output + JOINT_TREE occupation output, paired within each model seed) retain the point utility expected from its components, reduce coalition SEX recovery materially below continued task fitting (TASK_REFIT E20), and beat the eligible neural control (NEURAL_RAW rho1.0 E2)? Each answered separately, then the conjunction.

registration_status: EXPLORATORY DEVELOPMENT FOLLOW-UP of the already-opened ACS DEV_REPORT results. Not confirmation, not an independent replication, not a rescue of the source claim. Source labels stay unchanged: RECIPE_EFFECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED, NOT_SUPERIOR_TO_ALL_ELIGIBLE (complete), SUBGROUP_UNRESOLVED, benchmark SUPPORTED. A public receipt does not make the already-exposed data confirmatory.
scope_and_selection: H_LJ was fixed after the DEV_REPORT results of its components were public (the source published, for LOCAL_TREE and JOINT_TREE, recovery on all three views, all 12 utility clauses per seed and both subgroup guards). The alpha guarantees assume a roster fixed independently of DEV_REPORT, so the error rates are nominal and every label is exploratory, not confirmation.

Already public: the 24 utility clauses and the 4 subgroup guards are exact recomputations of published values (same outputs, labels and draws, hence the same points, SEs and alpha/3 bounds); the H_LJ income worsening endpoint is the source RECIPE income worsening endpoint (if the reader replay holds); the point of the H_LJ occupation worsening endpoint follows from published AUCs.

New: only the H_LJ and H_JL pair-view recovery. Six primary endpoints carry new information: the two coalition benefits vs TASK_REFIT, the two COMPETITIVE benefits and the two increments. The outcomes already settled are written below (settled_before_readers) so that none is reported as a finding.

Scope: all intervals and decisions are conditional on the frozen defense models and the fitted readers; the two seeds share people and are not independent evaluation populations ("both seeds" is a two-fit replication); the target is the unweighted DEV_REPORT household superpopulation, not ACS survey-design variance; PWGTP values are points only; the source labels are unchanged and the sealed assessment stays closed.
